Here is the weekly ASX X thread for the week of 5 October 2026:

Post 1

ASX closed at 8,247 pts last week and the question this week is simple: can it hold gains with global rate uncertainty creeping back in. Mixed bias — bulls need macro to cooperate. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🏦 Banks face RBA meeting scrutiny on rate guidance. ⛏️ Miners watch China PMI follow-through after last week's data. Two sectors, two catalysts — both binary. #banking #mining #ASX

Post 3

📉 One stock to watch: BHP. Iron ore at USD 98/t keeps margin pressure real. Any China stimulus signal this week flips the trade fast. #ASX #ironore #mining

Post 4

S&P 500 closed near 5,710 pts. US payrolls data lands Friday — a beat above 200k jobs risks pushing yields higher, which historically drags ASX financials and REITs hard. #ASX #ausbiz #inflation

Post 5

RBA decision Tuesday is the week's pin risk. Market prices no change to 3.85%. A hawkish hold spooks property; a dovish tilt lifts banks. Which way are you positioned? #RBA #ASX #ausbiz

Post 1

4.30 points. That's all the ASX 200 added Monday, closing at 8,686.40. Flat on the week, flat year-to-date. The index is treading water while sectors beneath the surface are pulling in opposite directions. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🟢 Health Care led at +0.74%, Materials added +0.36%. 🔴 Consumer Discretionary dragged hardest at -0.88%, Telcos -0.51%, IT -0.48%. Defensives and resources holding while the growth and spending names bleed. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3

📈 COH surged +4.20% to AUD 130.66, adding AUD 5.27 in a single session. Cochlear was the large-cap standout on a day short of catalysts — a reminder that quality health care names can run on thin volume. #healthcare #ASX

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,017.07/oz with AUD/USD at 0.6945. A weaker Aussie dollar is doing real work amplifying gold returns for local holders. Silver at AUD 88.78/oz. #gold #silver #metals #ASX

Post 5

Watch gold's AUD 6,000/oz floor. If AUD/USD firms above 0.70, that buffer compresses fast for local miners. Does gold hold its ground this week, or does currency drag erase the bid? Drop your call below. #gold #ausbiz #ASX
